parameters.name: BackendName
parameters.description: The name of the backend service. You can use \* to perform fuzzy queries.

parameters.name: BackendType
parameters.description: The type of the backend service.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the current page.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi describe-backend-list --backend-name test --backend-type HTTP --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --tag Value=value Key=test1 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
